# Diagnosable connected embedded system

Integrate the theory and practical evidence from modules 40–46. Submit a safe, reproducible engineering package rather than only a working artifact.
learningObjectives: Translate requirements into a circuit or system architecture
Use calculations and datasheet limits to select components
Plan safe measurements and objective verification
Diagnose at least one injected or simulated fault
